topic: My first job interview in English
passage: Last Tuesday, I attended my first job interview in English, and I felt nervous before it started. The company invited me for a video call at nine in the morning. I woke up early, put on a clean shirt, and checked my camera twice. When the call started, the interviewer smiled and welcomed me warmly. She asked me to introduce myself, so I talked about my work as a Java developer and the projects I had finished in the past three years. Then she asked about a difficult problem I had solved, and I explained how my team fixed a slow system by changing the database. She listened carefully and asked many questions about my English study. I told her that I practiced listening every morning and that I wanted to work with a team in another country. At the end, she thanked me and said the team would reply within a week. After the call ended, I wrote down every question I remembered. Although I felt tired, I felt proud because I had finished the whole interview in English.

shadow_sentences.text: I had my first job interview in English last Tuesday.
The interviewer asked me to talk about my work.
I felt nervous, but I finished the whole interview.

coach_rationale: 今天继续本周重点：过去式动词结尾 -ed/-t/-d 的听辨（10 月 10 日听写 64%，gave/showed/felt 系统性丢分），文里埋了 attended、invited、welcomed、explained、finished 等 20 多个过去式动词；同时加练短语动词连读 put on、woke up、write down，呼应你 EnglishPod 笔记里 pick up a、fill me in 这类连读弱项。Mac 通道本轮不通（restore 后仍连不上），按日志错题模式出题。主题换成工作——第一次用英语面试，B1 复合句（although、because、when）密度保持，听写仍按 B1、跟读保持 A2。
